title: Head and Hand
label: ch:ml-head-and-hand
canDo: I can name the head and the hand in Malayalam.

payoff.summary: Complete ML-C13-checkpoint, the chapter's closing checkpoint: say tala and kai and match them with Tamil's talai and kai, find ത in തല and ട in രണ്ട്, then write both letters from sound.
payoff.note: ML-C13-checkpoint (sequence 418, ML-PATH-017 order 1, after ML-S117-letter-tta and before chapter 14's first lesson) assesses all three atoms the chapter introduces (3/3). It is the payoff because ത (ML-S08-letter-ta, 415) and ട (ML-S117-letter-tta, 416) are taught after the spoken lesson ML-C13-shareera-bhaagangal (410), which could honestly assess only head and hand (1/3); that lesson stays as the chapter's spoken lesson. Both script lessons sit on the earlier ML-PATH-100 segment, so the checkpoint comes after all three on the sequence and on the path.
